name: Iseganan (IB-367)
metric: 90-100% hemolysis at 99.6 µM; 80-90% cytotoxicity at 80.5 µM
notes: Primary liability signal is host-cell toxicity with a very narrow therapeutic index despite antibacterial activity.

name: Pexiganan (MSI-78)
metric: Phase III failure: not superior to standard antibiotic care in infected diabetic foot ulcers
notes: Clinical liability is poor translation even with measurable activity; useful as a negative for late-stage selection models.

name: Temporin-SHf
notes: High MIC in antifungal assay indicates weak potency; useful near-negative comparator when screening for minimal potency cutoff.
